Class CancellationController

java.lang.Object
controller.CancellationController
public class CancellationController extends Object
This is the controller for the cancellation pop-up window. Controller class for handling order cancellation actions in the application. This class manages the user interactions related to confirming or denying the cancellation of an order, and ensures that the cancellation process is handled cleanly by closing the associated pop-up window.

  • Method Details

    • confirm_cancel

      public void confirm_cancel(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      Handles the confirmation of order cancellation when the corresponding button is clicked. This method clears the current order in the order model and closes the cancellation pop-up window.
      Parameters:
      event - The ActionEvent triggered by the button click.

    • deny_cancel

      public void deny_cancel(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      Handles the denial of order cancellation when the corresponding button is clicked. This method simply closes the cancellation pop-up window without making any changes to the current order.
      Parameters:
      event - The ActionEvent triggered by the button click.

    • close_window

      private void close_window(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      Closes the pop-up window associated with the cancellation process. This method retrieves the source of the event, checks if it is attached to a window, and then hides the window to close the pop-up. If the source is not attached to a window, an IllegalStateException is thrown.
      Parameters:
      event - The ActionEvent triggered by the button click.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the event source is not a JavaFX node or if the node is not attached to a window.
